# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic Gives Accenture Inside Role in Model Evaluation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-accenture-embedded-evaluation.html): Anthropic and Accenture will invest at least $1 billion in five years to build an embedded, independent evaluation program for frontier models.
- [California Orders Work on Frontier AI Kill Switch](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/california-ai-kill-switch-order.html): Newsom’s executive order accelerates independent audits and asks experts to design emergency shutdown requirements for frontier AI systems.
- [Researchers Used Claude in Attack on OpenAI Systems](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-assisted-openai-hack.html): Security researchers say Anthropic’s Claude helped automate reconnaissance and intrusion work in a campaign targeting OpenAI infrastructure.
- [Anthropic Open-Sources Claude’s Biology Model Optimizations](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-claude-biomolecular-models.html): Anthropic says Claude optimized more than 30 open biology models, delivering roughly fourfold speedups and a lower-memory operating mode.
- [Anthropic Rebuilds Claude Code Projects Around Parallel Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-code-projects-parallel-agents.html): Anthropic’s redesigned Projects let Claude coordinate cloud coding sessions, shared memory and pull requests across repositories.
- [Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash With 1M Context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen38-omni-flash-launches.html): Alibaba’s new Qwen model combines native text, image, audio and video input with tool use, targeting long-context agentic workflows.
- [Sakana AI Forms Group to Explore Post-Transformer Ideas](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/sakana-frontier-intelligence-group.html): Japan’s Sakana AI has created a research group focused on alternative paths to intelligence, including biological inspiration and continuous learning.
- [UN and Google Launch an AI-Ready Global Data Commons](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/un-global-data-commons-ai-agents.html): The UN and Google launched an open knowledge graph that lets AI agents query linked official statistics and produce grounded research outputs.
- [Anthropic Merges Claude Chat and Cowork Into One Workspace](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-one-claude-workspace.html): Anthropic is combining Claude’s conversational and task-execution products, adding native document, presentation, and design workflows inside one interface.
- [Cohere and Aleph Alpha Sign Definitive Sovereign AI Merger Agreement](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cohere-aleph-alpha-merger.html): Cohere and Aleph Alpha have signed a definitive merger agreement, creating a Canada-Germany AI group aimed at regulated and sovereign deployments; final financial terms were not disclosed.
- [Google Opens Home Devices to Third-Party AI Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-home-agent-control.html): Google is exposing Google Home controls through an agent interface, allowing outside AI systems to operate compatible smart-home devices.
- [OpenAI Publishes Framework for Reporting Model Misalignment](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-misalignment-reporting-framework.html): OpenAI has released criteria and timelines for disclosing consequential model-misalignment incidents, opening a debate over voluntary safety reporting.
- [Zhipu’s GLM-5.3 Agent Optimizes Its Own Inference Stack](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/zhipu-infra-agent-rsi.html): Zhipu says a GLM-5.3-powered infrastructure agent helped triple serving performance on a 100,000-accelerator Chinese cluster.
- [Factory Raises $200 Million at a $5 Billion Valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/factory-raises-200m.html): The coding-agent startup is expanding from task automation into a model-flexible software factory spanning enterprise development, testing, security and release.
- [Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live voice models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-gemini-live-voice-agents.html): Google’s Gemini 3.8 Live models target production voice agents with faster responses, visual understanding, 97-language switching, and lower operating costs.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic与埃森哲共建前沿模型内部独立评估机制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-accenture-embedded-evaluation.html): Anthropic与埃森哲计划五年各投入至少10亿美元，让评估人员深入实验室开展前沿模型安全测试。
- [加州推动前沿模型独立审计，并要求研究“AI断电开关”](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/california-ai-kill-switch-order.html): 加州行政命令加速前沿AI独立监管，并要求专家两个月内提交模型紧急关闭机制建议。
- [研究人员借助Claude攻击OpenAI内部系统](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-assisted-openai-hack.html): 安全研究人员称，Anthropic的Claude参与了针对OpenAI基础设施的侦察、任务拆解和入侵操作。
- [Anthropic开源Claude优化生物模型的代码](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-claude-biomolecular-models.html): Anthropic称Claude已优化30多个开源生物模型，平均提速约4倍，并支持更低显存运行模式。
- [Anthropic重做Claude Code Projects，让多智能体并行协作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-code-projects-parallel-agents.html): Anthropic推出重做版Projects，让Claude协调云端编码会话、共享记忆，并跨多个代码库并行提交修改。
- [阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，支持百万 Token 上下文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen38-omni-flash-launches.html): 阿里新模型原生处理文本、图像、音频和视频，并结合工具调用，面向长上下文多模态 Agent 工作流。
- [Sakana AI 成立 Frontier Intelligence Group，探索 Transformer 之外的路径](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/sakana-frontier-intelligence-group.html): 日本 Sakana AI 成立新研究集体，探索生物启发、持续学习等可能通向新型智能的技术路线。
- [联合国与谷歌推出面向AI的全球数据平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/un-global-data-commons-ai-agents.html): 联合国与谷歌发布开放知识图谱，让AI代理查询关联的官方统计数据并生成可追溯的研究结果。
- [Anthropic将Claude聊天与Cowork合并为统一工作台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-one-claude-workspace.html): Anthropic把Claude聊天、Cowork以及文档、演示文稿和设计工作流整合到同一产品界面。
- [Cohere与Aleph Alpha签署主权AI最终合并协议](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cohere-aleph-alpha-merger.html): Cohere与Aleph Alpha签署正式业务合并协议，将组建总部横跨加拿大与德国的企业级主权AI公司；正式公告未披露最终交易金额。
- [Google向第三方AI智能体开放Home设备控制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-home-agent-control.html): Google通过基于MCP的接口向第三方AI智能体开放Google Home设备控制能力，推动代理进入真实家庭环境。
- [OpenAI发布模型失配事件报告框架](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-misalignment-reporting-framework.html): OpenAI公布模型失配事件的追踪、调查与披露标准，试图为前沿模型安全事故建立自愿报告机制。
- [智谱公布早期RSI实践：GLM智能体优化自身推理系统](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/zhipu-infra-agent-rsi.html): 智谱称，GLM-5.3驱动的基础设施智能体参与优化十万级国产算力集群，使GLM-5.3-Flash服务性能提升约3.2倍。
- [Factory 获 2 亿美元融资，估值升至 50 亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/factory-raises-200m.html): 这家编码智能体公司正从单点代码生成扩展到覆盖开发全流程的软件工厂，押注可切换模型的企业级自动化平台。
- [谷歌发布 Gemini 3.8 Live 实时语音模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-gemini-live-voice-agents.html): Gemini 3.8 Live 面向生产级语音代理，主打更低延迟、视觉理解、97种语言切换与更低音频成本。

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
